descriptive_name: The primary carrier of fire in GR1 is sparse grass though small amounts of fine dead fuel may be present
The primary carrier of fire in SH5 is woody shrubs and shrub litter
The primary carrier of fire in TL2 is broadleaf (hardwood) litter
Fuel model NB1 consists of land covered by urban and suburban development
Land covered by permanent snow or ice is included in NB2
Fuel model NB3 is agricultural land maintained in a nonburnable condition
Land covered by open bodies of water such as lakes rivers and oceans comprises NB8
Land devoid of enough fuel to support wildland fire spread is covered by fuel model NB9
